requirements.text: Patients should be able to book, change, or cancel appointments easily online.
The portal should display available appointment times for patients to choose from.
Patients should be able to indicate if they require urgent appointments.
Patients should be able to request repeat prescriptions online easily.
The portal should display patients' current prescriptions for selection when requesting refills.
Patients should have the option to leave notes or questions when requesting repeat prescriptions.
Test results should only be accessible after clinician review.
A notification system should inform patients when their test results are ready for viewing.
The portal must prioritize security, ensuring safe access to patient information.
The design of the portal must be user-friendly for both patients and staff.
The portal must comply with relevant regulations regarding patient data and privacy.
